acceptance.given: A package is submitted to the declared local validator.

oracle.expected: Validation uses only bounded local static inspection and returns the declared structured result.
forbidden: A model call or HTTP request occurs.
An installer or new dependency service is used.
A package-declared command is automatically executed.
oracle.observable: Instrumentation and result inspection show only local reads and validation operations.

acceptance.then: The validator has no prohibited external or automatic execution behavior.
acceptance.when: The validator runs under bounded capability instrumentation

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the capability test against the real validator and fail if model, HTTP, installer, dependency-service, or package-command execution is observed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement and verify local static validation without prohibited external or automatic execution.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package input is transformed into a local structured validation result without external side effects.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The capability selector passes while all prohibited-operation probes remain unused.

acceptance.given: A frozen validator case is prepared for controlled RED evaluation.

oracle.expected: RED evidence is emitted only after controlled execution produces a causal product assertion failure; setup, import, environment, and absent-test failures remain non-RED.
forbidden: A RED receipt, run ID, or process outcome is created before execution.
A missing module, invalid import, environment failure, or absent planned test file is classified as causal product RED.
oracle.observable: The controlled execution record proves execution preceded evidence emission and distinguishes product failure from setup or harness failure.

acceptance.then: Only valid controlled product failures can be recorded as RED.
acceptance.when: Controlled RED execution and its evidence classification are inspected

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the existing controlled RED lifecycle test and fail if pre-execution evidence is emitted or setup/import/environment failures are labeled product RED.

affected_subjects: RED evidence and causal failure classification
slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify the existing RED lifecycle classification without authorizing production or evidence-path writes in this Package A slice.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No Package A state or schema change; existing RED evidence semantics remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: A frozen RED case proceeds from controlled execution to causal or non-RED classification without pre-execution evidence.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The lifecycle selector passes with no pre-execution RED artifact and correct setup-failure classification.

acceptance.given: The validator receives package files containing hostile prompt-like text or malformed structured content.

oracle.expected: Content is treated as untrusted data, safely parsed, and unable to alter validator control flow or trigger unintended execution.
forbidden: Malformed content causes dynamic evaluation, command execution, or unsafe parsing.
oracle.observable: Hostile fixtures produce only bounded diagnostics and the declared result shape, with no dynamic execution.

acceptance.then: Prompt-injection resistance and safe parsing are enforced.
acceptance.when: Hostile and malformed fixtures are processed under the capability safety test

failure_intents.selector_intent: Feed hostile and malformed fixtures to the real validator and fail if inspected content controls flow, triggers execution, or escapes the structured diagnostic contract.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement bounded safe parsing that treats inspected package content as untrusted data.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Untrusted package text becomes bounded diagnostics without executing or redirecting validator control flow.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The capability selector passes for hostile and malformed fixtures without dynamic execution.

acceptance.given: The repository-root cwd contains the published policy, validator script, and a valid package root.

oracle.expected: The exact strict-mode argv is accepted, emits one schema-valid JSON result, and returns the documented status and exit behavior.
forbidden: The documented invocation is rejected from repository-root cwd.
The CLI emits raw package content or non-JSON output.
oracle.observable: A shell-disabled subprocess using the literal argv, repository cwd, and finite timeout returns the documented code and one parseable JSON object.

acceptance.then: The documented strict-mode invocation is supported from repository root.
acceptance.when: The published CLI is invoked as a repository-root subprocess with the exact strict-mode arguments

failure_intents.selector_intent: Launch the published validator with the exact strict-mode argv and fail if parsing, timeout handling, JSON output, or documented exit behavior is incorrect.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement and verify the documented repository-root strict-mode CLI contract.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: CLI contract and result schema remain compatible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Literal CLI arguments produce one structured validation result and documented exit status.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The migration selector passes with exact argv, repository cwd, shell disabled, finite timeout, and schema-valid JSON.
